prompt: 想強調「是小美打破了花瓶」，哪一句正確？
options: It was Mei who broke the vase.
It was Mei broke who the vase.
It Mei was who broke the vase.
answer: It was Mei who broke the vase.

who 要緊接在被強調的 Mei 後面，並作為 broke 的主詞，不能插在動詞後面。
分裂句的順序是 It + be + 強調部分，be 動詞要緊跟在 It 後面。

why: 分裂句 It is/was + 強調部分 + that/who ...，強調人時可以用 who。
tip: It is／was + 焦點 + that／who，用來強調。
say: It was Mei who broke the vase.

text: It was in the library _____ I lost my wallet.
options: that
what
where is

wrong.what: 分裂句的連接詞要用 that（或 who／which），不能用 what。
wrong.where is: where is 會讓句子變成疑問或時態不一致；分裂句通常直接用 that 接後半句。

why: 被強調的是地點 in the library，後面接 that 完成 It was ... that ... 的分裂句。
tip: 強調地點、時間，後面也用 that。
say: It was in the library that I lost my wallet.

text: It was last Friday that the team won the final.
options: 球隊是在上週五贏得決賽。
球隊上週五贏了，其他場次輸了。
球隊在決賽中輸給了對手。
answer: 球隊是在上週五贏得決賽。

wrong.球隊上週五贏了，其他場次輸了。: 句子只強調時間是上週五，沒有提到其他場次的勝負。
wrong.球隊在決賽中輸給了對手。: won the final 是贏得決賽，與輸掉完全相反。

why: It was last Friday that 把時間 last Friday 放在焦點，強調贏球的時間。
tip: 分裂句的焦點在 It was 和 that 之間。
say: It was last Friday that the team won the final.

prompt: 同學誤以為你昨天買了書，你想糾正：「我昨天買的是筆記本，不是書。」
options: It was a notebook that I bought yesterday, not a book.
I was a notebook that bought yesterday, not a book.
It bought a notebook yesterday, not a book.
answer: It was a notebook that I bought yesterday, not a book.

wrong.I was a notebook that bought yesterday,: I was 變成「我是筆記本」，意思錯誤，也漏掉了分裂句的開頭 It。
wrong.It bought a notebook yesterday, not a bo: It 在這裡變成買東西的主詞，沒有形成分裂句，也不能糾正對方。

why: 要糾正並強調 a notebook，用 It was a notebook that ... 表示「是…而不是…」。
tip: 糾正誤會時，用分裂句強調正確的資訊。
say: It was a notebook that I bought yesterday, not a book.

prompt: 哪一句偽分裂句（pseudo-cleft）是正確的？
options: What I want is a cup of hot tea.
What I want are a cup of hot tea.
That I want is a cup of hot tea.
answer: What I want is a cup of hot tea.

a cup of hot tea 是單數，be 動詞用 is，不能用 are。
偽分裂句用 What 開頭，意思是「我想要的是…」，That 不能代替。

why: What I want is ... 是偽分裂句，what 子句當主詞，後面的 be 動詞配合補語數量，這裡是單數 is。
tip: What 子句 + be + 焦點，be 配合後面的名詞。
say: What I want is a cup of hot tea.

text: It is the lack of sleep _____ makes students lose focus.
options: that
what
whose

wrong.what: 分裂句中 that 引導的是修飾焦點的子句，what 本身已含先行詞，兩者不能同用。
wrong.whose: whose 表示所屬關係，這裡缺的是主詞，不是所有格。

why: 被強調的是 the lack of sleep，且後面子句缺主詞，用 that 引導。
tip: 強調主詞時，that 後面直接接動詞。
say: It is the lack of sleep that makes students lose focus.

prompt: 下列哪一個選項與句子意思最接近？
text: What surprised me was how quiet the room was.
options: 讓我驚訝的是房間竟然這麼安靜。
我很驚訝你們說話太大聲。
房間很吵，我一點也不驚訝。
answer: 讓我驚訝的是房間竟然這麼安靜。

wrong.我很驚訝你們說話太大聲。: 句子說房間很安靜（quiet），不是太吵。
wrong.房間很吵，我一點也不驚訝。: surprised 表示驚訝，而且 quiet 是安靜，兩個重點都相反。

why: What surprised me was ... 是偽分裂句，焦點是 how quiet the room was。
tip: What ... was 後面才是重點資訊。
say: What surprised me was how quiet the room was.

prompt: 想強調「是這場雨取消了比賽」，哪一句分裂句正確？
options: It was the rain that cancelled the game.
It was the rain that the game was cancelled.
It the rain was that cancelled the game.
answer: It was the rain that cancelled the game.

wrong.It was the rain that the game was cancel: the rain 已是焦點，that 後面卻又補了完整的子句 the game was cancelled，結構重複不通。
分裂句的 be 動詞要緊接在 It 後面，It was the rain，不能把 was 放到 the rain 後。

why: 焦點 the rain 就是 cancelled 的主詞，所以 that 後面直接接動詞，不再重複主詞。
tip: 焦點是主詞，that 後面不能再有主詞。
say: It was the rain that cancelled the game.

prompt: 老師問：「誰把窗戶打開的？」你要回答：「是阿明開的。」哪個回答最自然、有強調？
options: It was Ming who opened it.
It Ming opened.
Opened it was Ming.
answer: It was Ming who opened it.

缺少 be 動詞與 who，句子不完整，無法形成分裂句。
語序混亂，英文不能把 Opened 放句首後再接 it was Ming 來回答這個問題。

why: 回答 Who 問句時，可以用 It was ... who ... 強調做事的人。
tip: 回答 who 問句，用 It was + 人 + who。
say: It was Ming who opened it.

text: It was not until midnight _____ the storm stopped.
options: that
when
and

wrong.when: It was not until ... 後面固定接 that，不用 when。
wrong.and: and 只是連接兩句，不能構成 It was not until ... that 的強調結構。

why: It was not until A that B 是固定的分裂句，意思是「直到 A 才 B」。
tip: It was not until A that B：直到 A 才 B。
say: It was not until midnight that the storm stopped.

prompt: Anna 說：「It wasn't the price that bothered me; it was the poor service.」她真正不滿意的是什麼？
options: 服務很差
價格太貴
店太遠

wrong.價格太貴: wasn't the price 已經否定了價格，所以不是價格的問題。
wrong.店太遠: 句中沒有提到距離，無法判斷與店的位置有關。

why: It wasn't ... that ...; it was ... 是用否定加肯定來排除一個、強調另一個。
tip: It wasn't A; it was B，重點在 B。
say: It wasn't the price that bothered me; it was the poor service.
